contrast: Masked versus unmasked geometry pretraining transferred to CFD pressure tasks
geometry_checkpoints: Final epoch_11.pt for masked_native/unmasked_native, geometry seeds17,18,19; all 10626 updates. Do not select the best geometry checkpoint separately by arm.
data: Existing DoubleDelta train11-16/val17/test18-19 with geometry families separated
paired_controls: Identical native trainer, inputs, loss, examples, ordering seed, observation RNG, field-head initialization, update budget and validation-selection rule within each seed. Equal updates does not assert equal geometry-pretraining FLOPs.
uncertainty: Paired differences over seeds and physical geometry groups; 5000 bootstrap draws, jointly resample seeds and geometry families. Primary endpoints use97.5% intervals for a two-endpoint family.
allowed_claim: A supported gain establishes a masking contribution under the tested pretraining and field-training recipes; it does not alone uniquely identify an inverse-operator mechanism.
release: Keep all outcomes including non-improvements; no stopping at a favourable seed or sensor count
